name: Sanctioning of Tricycles of Orthopedically Challenged
benefit: - Eligible beneficiaries receive a free tricycle to improve their mobility and independence.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should have 40% or above disability and meet the eligibility criteria as specified in the [RPwD Act, 2016](https://cdnbbsr.s3waas.gov.in/s3e58aea67b01fa747687f038dfde066f6/uploads/2023/10/202310161053958942.pdf).1. The applicant should be eligible for sanction only once in three years. 1. The applicant's family annual income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/-.
